name: Marjoram
description: Oregano's milder cousin — sweeter, and it fades if cooked too long.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and tikshna, in the aromatic group.

unani.note: Marzanjosh is garam-khushk in the classical materia medica.

histamine.note: Very low as a dried herb.

nutrition.highlight: add it late, or it fades
